checks: Batch visibility is current when returning to a previously cached page; loaded 60-image window retains its 58 surviving cards and continues after the unchanged original cursor of a removed anchor, without reloading page one.

The approved tag Drawer renders one readable list, 44px footer actions and long names without visible UUIDs, with 360/390×600 scrolling and real Escape/Space focus. Real target search and paging preserve explicit choices; normalized duplicates are rejected; quick creation persists and selects a real tag; add/remove submit the exact three target IDs and persist then remove every image relationship.

add-tags: actual per-image SQL failure retains its result and valid selection without success Toast; explicit retry sends only the failed ID, persists the requested relationship, returns to the original page and restores focus with truthful Toast counts.

remove-tags: actual per-image SQL failure retains its result and valid selection without success Toast; explicit retry sends only the failed ID, persists the requested relationship, returns to the original page and restores focus with truthful Toast counts.

add-tags: lost apply/check responses preserve the frozen result and chooser draft; X, footer, Escape and backdrop each release the modal and reopen without replaying a write. Explicit read-only recheck confirms the same IDs, returns with truthful unchanged counts and restores focus.

remove-tags: lost apply/check responses preserve the frozen result and chooser draft; X, footer, Escape and backdrop each release the modal and reopen without replaying a write. Explicit read-only recheck confirms the same IDs, returns with truthful unchanged counts and restores focus.

Real public/private writes send only the image needing change, report one changed item, retain both matching selections and the exact original library page or album route, and render readable 44px feedback in desktop/mobile light/dark themes.

Actual public/private UPDATE failures return one committed image and two retained failures across pages; viewing the dedicated retained page performs no request and shows an actual failed sample, one current-page/one other-page failure and actual causes; explicit retry sends only failed IDs, persists all three target visibility values, returns to the exact original page with a native two-changed success Toast and retains all three matching selections.

Confirmed real writes wait for a held successful list GET before completion; losing that successful GET retains truthful write counts and explains refresh failure, closes the workspace and returns focus without pretending the writes failed.
